mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with mefloquine creates additive CNS depression and seizure risk, plus mefloquine's cardiac effects may be potentiated by MAOI activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if mefloquine prophylaxis is essential, discontinue isocarboxazid at least 14 days prior and do not resume until 24 hours after final mefloquine dose.
